name: Consumer-Driven Contract (CDC) Pact Header Drift
description: Provider service changed tracing header from 'X-Correlation-Id' to W3C standard 'traceparent', breaking consumer Pact verification.

failure_vector.error_log: PactVerificationError: Expected header 'X-Correlation-Id' with UUID format but header was missing. Actual headers: {'traceparent': '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01'}
